Decoding the PROCTITLE hex: "cat /etc/puppetlabs/puppetserver/ca/ca_key.pem". The log shows a root-owned `cat` process (auid unset, no login session) reading the Puppet CA private key, a highly sensitive credential file. Reading a CA private key from a shell with no audit login identity is an unusual and high-risk action, consistent with credential access.
